name: NEC Capital Solutions Limited
summary: NEC Capital Solutions Limited provides financial services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Leasing Business, Finance Business, Investment Business, and Other Business. The Leasing Business segment is involved in the leasing, rental, and installment sale of information communication equipment, office equipment, and other various facilities and equipment; and sale of goods related to leasing, sale of properties due to expiration or early cancellation, maintenance services for leased equipment, etc. The Finance Business segment comprises money lending, factoring, securities investment, etc. for the purpose of receiving dividend income.
